newsitem.title: USA: TVA 1,148 MW nuke reaches full power output.
newsitem.headline: TVA 1,148 MW nuke reaches full power output.

text.p: Tennessee Valley Authority's (TVA) 1,148 megawatt Sequoyah nuclear power unit 2 was operating at full power as of early Tuesday, returning from a repair outage, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit in Soddy-Daisy, Tenn., was operating at 100 percent capacity, boosting power from 50 percent Monday, NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Sequoyah 2 was shut Friday due to an electrical problem that resulted in the loss of two reactor coolant pumps, and resumed power output over the weekend.
The 1,148 megawatt Sequoyah nuclear power unit 1 continued to operate normally at 100 percent of capacity as of early Tuesday, NRC said.
